text: Read-only UI: visible hint, and edit attempts answered with a warning toast
description: When the open project is read-only, the normal UI stays fully navigable (columns, graph, search, inbox view) but shows a persistent 'read-only' hint in the header. Every edit path (edit/create/delete keys, drag and drop, modals, inbox accept) shows a warning toast saying editing is not possible instead of acting. Prefer one central guard in the stores over per-component checks.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: The warning on edit attempts is shown as a toast.

status.comment:
Read-only badge + central mutation guard with warning toasts, verified in the running app on a read-only scratch copy; awaiting acceptance.

utils/read-only.ts: readOnlyGuardLink (first tRPC link) refuses every mutation of a project the backend reported not writable (project.getAccess, loaded with getMeta in loadProject), except viewer state (phase.setCursor, project.buildSearchIndex); nothing is sent. Toast store converts read-only refusals (guard or backend guard) into one warning with the plain reason; ReviewInboxModal routes them there. Header badge 'read-only' with the reason as tooltip. Backend: injectAgentInstructions now guarded too (writes CLAUDE.md etc. into the repo).

Evidence: read-only.test.ts (3: refused before sending / queries+setCursor+other projects pass / warning toast instead of error); live app on a copy of this graph with runtime/read-only: badge visible, inbox accept answered by the warning toast, copied ideas/phases/meta byte-identical afterwards; pnpm check 25/25 (a first commit 4ef1c33 slipped past a failing MultiClient mock because the gate's exit status was piped away; fixed in the next commit).
